sloka: यादृशं लक्ष्यते रूपं यथा चैव श्रुतं मया ।व्यक्तं प्राप्ता: स्म तं देशं भरद्वाजो यमब्रवीत् ॥ २.९३.७॥
transliteration: yādṛśaṁ lakṣyate rūpaṁ yathā caiva śrutaṁ mayā ।vyaktaṁ prāptā: sma taṁ deśaṁ bharadvājo yamabravīt ॥ 2.93.7॥

translations.english: Looking at these surroundings and from what I had heard, it is clear that we have reached the region indicated by Bharadwaja.
